headline: Government approves 2027 minimum wage increase: 1,286 euros gross in 14 payments and no income tax withholding
summary: The Council of Ministers approved a 2027 minimum wage of 1,286 euros gross in 14 payments, 65 euros more per month, effective January 1 and without income tax withholding.
why: The minimum wage sets a floor for pay across Spain and affects labour costs for employers, particularly in retail and hospitality. Changes also feed into inflation and consumer spending.
